SO! Writing here in case it helps you too, because it sure was hard to find the answer to!
There is something called object groups, which is a list of objects you can make. Everywhere you can put an onject in the code, you can put in an "object group" to make it affect ALL things in that list.
If you give the object group an object variable, that variable will be give to each object on that list AND each object can have a different value on that variable.

It's kinda wonky, but look at the code in setup and reset position to see it in action. Make a "repeat for each instance of [objectGroup]", pick your object group (It's at the bottom of the object list), choose "change variable".
In the "set to ingredients.X()" part, ingredients is the object group containing every ingredient object, but because we are "repeating for each instance", it is using the object in the object group that is currently being affected by the code.

Aka, this code sets the variable startx to current X position, and will do so for each and every object in the object group, individually.
